issues.title: www host serves 200 duplicate content (no redirect to apex)
issues.evidence: https://www.houstonluxuryremodeling.com/ and /houston return 200 with x-ms-nextjs-render: cache; http://www -> https://www (301) then 200. Canonical tags on www pages point to apex, which mitigates.
issues.cause: Azure Static Web Apps edge cache serves prerendered HTML without invoking Next.js middleware; next.config redirects with host condition are not applied by SWA hybrid hosting.
issues.impact: Duplicate hosts dilute signals; before 2026-09-20 canonicals + sitemap pointed at www, so Google's earliest-discovered URLs are likely www URLs that now canonicalize elsewhere.

issues.title: Azure default hostname gray-tree-00f55e310.4.azurestaticapps.net serves full indexable site
issues.evidence: 200, meta robots index,follow, canonical -> apex, robots.txt Allow: /.
issues.cause: SWA default hostname is always public unless a default custom domain is set.
issues.impact: Third duplicate host; mitigated by canonical.

issues.title: Trailing-slash URLs return 200 instead of redirecting
issues.cause: Same SWA cache layer; Next.js trailing-slash redirect not applied.

issues.title: Canonical host changed www -> apex on 2026-09-20
issues.evidence: Commit e0d03b4 (2026-09-20): SITE_URL default changed from www to apex; previously every canonical and sitemap <loc> pointed to www. Commit message notes GSC sitemap 'Couldn't fetch'.
issues.impact: Google's first view of the site (2026-09-16..20) had conflicting host signals; some of the 11 known URLs are plausibly www URLs.
